cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two signatures on each school-trip form. Good. Check that they come from different people, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave the forms pending. Please don't count the waiting time as a delay; that's our independent check working.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's right. List her as author, not checker. We've caught a gap already; leave her signature box blank until an independent checker arrives.

reason: Use B's actual wait as the claimed safeguard; do not invent a proposal to sign twice.
